shots.frame: Poster-style face-off: the young K-pop idol Romeo (reference 1) and the old playwright (reference 2) standing nose to nose in profile on a Renaissance theatre stage, magenta light on Romeo, teal light on the playwright.
Medium shot of the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume) leaning toward the camera and pointing straight at the viewer, mouth closed.

Medium shot of the old playwright from the reference (same face and costume, headphones around neck) sitting at a candlelit wooden desk writing with a quill on parchment; a modern smartphone lies face-up beside the ink pot.
shots.motion: He glances at the glowing phone, ignores it, and keeps writing with the quill. Subtle candle flicker.

shots.frame: Medium close-up of the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume), holding his small glass poison vial pendant up beside his face with two fingers, dramatic tragic expression, mouth closed, eyes open.

Inside a candlelit Renaissance Globe-style wooden theatre, an audience in 1600s clothing sobbing dramatically, wiping tears with handkerchiefs, faces lit warm by candles, magenta and teal stage haze above.
shots.motion: The audience cries harder, handkerchiefs waving, slow push-in.

shots.frame: Medium shot of the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume), half turned away from the camera, looking back over his shoulder with an unimpressed eye-roll smirk, one hand raised in a lazy goodbye wave, mouth closed.

shots.note: Reuses the next shot's picture: the end of the s05 clip had a hand gesture that could read as rude.

shots.frame: Medium close-up of the old playwright from the reference (same face and costume, headphones around neck) leaning slowly toward the camera with a smug, patient look, mouth closed.

The young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume) standing below a stone Renaissance balcony at night in a moonlit orchard, gazing up longingly with a hand on his heart, full moon, romantic blue light.
shots.motion: He sighs dramatically and sways, hand on heart, gentle camera tilt up toward the balcony.

shots.frame: Night, torchlight: the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume) climbing a tall old stone orchard wall, determined, one hand reaching for the top.
shots.motion: He pulls himself up over the wall energetically.

shots.frame: A modern young adult lying in bed under a thick blanket in a dark bedroom, face lit blue by a smartphone, looking bored, messy hair.
shots.motion: They pull the blanket higher and keep scrolling, not getting up.

shots.frame: Medium close-up of the old playwright from the reference (same face and costume, headphones around neck), holding up a modern smartphone toward the camera with its screen facing the viewer, unimpressed raised eyebrow, mouth closed.

Wide shot on a Renaissance wooden theatre stage with K-pop concert lighting and haze: the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume) in the center doing a sharp idol dance pose, flanked by six backup dancers in Renaissance Verona costumes in formation.
shots.motion: Sharp synchronized K-pop choreography, hits on the beat, lights flash.

shots.frame: Medium shot of the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume) on the theatre stage, arms spread wide presenting the room, challenging expression, mouth closed.

From the stage looking out: a Renaissance theatre audience in 1600s clothing, every single person holding up a modern smartphone, many with ring lights, filming themselves and posing, faces lit by screens.
shots.motion: They pose and take selfies, ring lights glowing, slow pan.

shots.frame: Close-up of the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume), one hand on his chest, sarcastic sympathetic look, mouth closed, magenta rim light.
A crowded modern city street at night, everyone blurred and rushing past, one young adult standing still in the middle, face lit by a phone showing an empty chat, lonely.
shots.motion: The crowd streams past in a blur while they stay still, looking at the phone.

shots.frame: Medium close-up of the old playwright from the reference (same face and costume, headphones around neck), holding a human skull in one hand and a modern smartphone in the other, looking at the camera with mock seriousness, mouth closed.
Torchlit Renaissance town square at night: two rival families of swordsmen mid-fight, and a giant grey chat bubble with three typing dots floating between them, blocking the fight.
shots.motion: The swordsmen freeze and stare up at the floating typing bubble as its three dots pulse, torches flicker.

shots.frame: Medium shot of the old playwright from the reference (same face and costume, headphones around neck) on the theatre stage, bending down to set a smartphone on the wooden floor, looking up at the camera, mouth closed.

Comedic wide shot on a Renaissance wooden theatre stage: the young K-pop idol Romeo from the reference (same face and costume) running toward the stage exit in panic, a big brown bear chasing right behind him.
shots.motion: Romeo sprints off stage, the bear chases him, slapstick.

shots.frame: Medium-wide shot on a Renaissance wooden theatre stage with K-pop concert lights: the young K-pop idol Romeo (reference 1, same face and costume) and the old playwright (reference 2, same face and costume, headphones around neck) side by side, both rapping toward the camera with hand gestures, backup dancers behind.
shots.motion: Both rap and bounce to the beat with big hand gestures, dancers move behind them, lights pulse.

shots.frame: Wide concert shot of a Renaissance Globe-style theatre packed with cheering audience, confetti and stage lights; on stage the young K-pop idol Romeo (reference 1) and the old playwright (reference 2) jump with arms raised, backup dancers in Renaissance costume.
shots.motion: Confetti rains, crowd jumps, both performers jump on the beat, camera cranes up.

shots.frame: Medium shot: the young K-pop idol Romeo (reference 1, same face and costume) and the old playwright (reference 2, same face and costume) standing shoulder to shoulder, both pointing straight at the camera with cocky grins, stage lights behind.
shots.motion: They both point at the viewer and nod in sync.

shots.frame: Front row of a candlelit Renaissance wooden theatre: a big brown bear sitting calmly in a wooden seat among 1600s audience members, looking at the camera, deadpan.
shots.motion: The bear settles into the seat and calmly looks at the camera; people beside it stare at it.
